Scene: Rocky and Grace are about to part for their separate homeward journeys. Grace's fuel tanks have been repaired. They do not yet know the Taumoeba can escape xenonite.
I’m trying to think if there’s anything I forgot…
Oh, yeah, yeah, they’re working great.
Not sure what to say, so...just gonna…
Grace? No one to watch you sleep.
Oh, I don’t know about that.
You are bravest human I have ever met.
I only meet one human, and is you!
I get it. It’s a good joke.
But I won’t see you later.
I know. How do you say goodbye back home?
